title: Page 2
content_zh:
不经一事不长一智，进“一条龙”工作了半天，枣儿终于了解她爹爹平常多辛苦。她当天下工回家，累到连饭也吃不下，随便擦一擦手脚就睡了。
隔天天未亮，枣儿还是依平常习惯起了个大早，离上工的时刻还有段时间，枣儿忙拎着竹篮水瓢到屋后菜园，想着待会儿还要帮她爹备上整天的吃食。
“昨天真是吓死我了，听龙爷说话口气，我还以为我八成没望在‘一条龙’工作了，怎么知道他只是觉得我担不了水——说来还真是奇，想他身分地位多高呀，竟然还会替手底下人着想……”
杵在菜园子里说话，是枣儿自小就有的习惯。她成天一个人守着空屋，娘亲又早亡，有话想说时，当然只好跟不会应答的瓜果菜蔬说。
一边说，她脑子一边浮现龙焱俊朗的脸，坚毅的下颚，端整的眉，一双深不见底的黑眼睛。虽然枣儿见过的男人不多，但她可以拍胸脯保证，这个年轻当家绝对是附近万中选一的美男子。
“我本以为他长得更老更凶，想不到他这么年轻，说不定还不到而立年纪呢！”
说话时枣儿手里可没闲着，一双手活似彩蝶，每株苗秧，她都满满地浇上一瓢子水。
很快，枣儿摘了一小箩筐的豆荚。“嘿咻”一声站起，抹抹汗滴准备回家做饭，走着走着，她突然“哎呀”一声轻叫。
“瞧我这脑袋！”
她捧着箩筐，急急奔回家翻出她昨晚穿过的粗布衣裳。她怎么忘了，昨傍晚下工，账房塞给她半条腊肉，说是当家捎给她爹的慰劳。
怎知她累胡涂了，腊肉往怀里一塞，马上忘在脑后！
枣儿小心翼翼地拍去黏在腊肉上头的布渣，嗅嗅，一脸陶醉。真不愧是鼎鼎大名“一条龙”做的腊肉，香极了。她惦着她爹清瘦的身子，刚好可以乘这机会帮他补点油水。
不久，她切了几片肉下锅跟蒜苗一块炒，再佐上一锅稀粥。碗筷刚放好，她爹已闻香而来。
“小心点。”枣儿连忙去搀。
“这腊肉哪儿来？”石老庐按着伤腰坐下。
“龙爷给您的。”枣儿连忙盛了碗粥，还挟了一筷子肉往她爹碗里一搁。“试试。”
“想不到今年还有机会吃到腊肉。”石老庐双眼发亮地咀嚼。
“一条龙”对底下人并不小气，每到过年，当家总会发给他们每人半条腊羊腿作贺礼。枣儿总是小心再小心地用它，可半条羊腿能吃多久，不过个把月，就只能在睡梦中回忆那好滋味。
“你也吃点。”石老庐拨了几块肉到枣儿碗里。“工作还好吧？我看你回家倒头就睡，不敢吵你。”
枣儿边扒着粥边回答，末了，还添上几句感想：“龙爷割烹的手艺好惊人！我送盘子进去，瞧他‘剁剁剁’，下锅再翻一翻杓，一盘‘银丝牛肉’就好了。”

石老庐拔高了声音问：“你就杵在那儿看？”
“是啊，怎么了？”
“这怎么成！”石老庐猛拍额头。“昨儿你也听黄老爹说了，龙爷最忌讳女人进他灶房，虽然你现在乔扮成男孩，可毕竟还是个女娃！”
枣儿嘟嘴。“我只是想偷学点技巧……”
人称“易牙再世”的龙焱手艺之精湛，就连足不出户的枣儿也知道。况且她天生对割烹馔饮特感兴趣，难得有机会细看，要她忍住不瞧，简直要她命！
“想想龙爷对我们多好。”石老庐点点桌上的蒜苗腊肉，苦口婆心劝：“他就这么一点规矩，你忍心不从？”
“……好啦！”枣儿不情不愿。“不过我真搞不懂，龙爷干么排斥女人进灶房？古早不有句话，什么‘君子远庖厨’……”
“龙爷讨厌女人。”石老庐解了女儿疑惑。“好像是因为龙爷小时候，他娘丢下他和他爹，跟别人跑了。”
原来如此！枣儿惊愕地张大嘴。
“这事千万不能在龙爷面前提起，记得。”石老庐再三叮咛。
既然允了爹不再进灶房探头探脑，从第二天起，枣儿就改掉了在长屋窗门边打探的习惯。
“好可惜。”立在盘器房擦着杯盘的枣儿长叹一声。难得进来“一条龙”工作，又难得离灶房那么近——就在隔壁，可她却只能站在这儿空嗅香气，边想象龙爷他会是怎么翻锅舞杓……
“当男孩真好。”她小声嘟囔一句，轻手把擦好的盘摆到架上。
“是怎么着？一早就听你哀声叹气。”在庄里负责帮瓜果削皮的余盛正扛了一篓莱菔经过，忍不住好奇探头。
“余盛哥早。”枣儿边打着招呼，边把最后一只盘搁好，才拎着满篮的脏布巾来到余盛身边。余盛约长枣儿五岁，虽然是前辈，可因他人和气加上出没的地点相若——同样都是在井边，所以枣儿才跟他认识不久，两人马上混熟了。
“我只是在想我爹的吩咐，要我少靠近灶房叨扰龙爷。”
余盛呵呵笑了两声。“你想学割烹？”
心愿被看穿的枣儿有些尴尬。“是有一点意思……”
“如果想学，你就闯错门啦！”一到井边，余盛马上放下篓子，拍拍里边那把锋利的薄刃。“你得先学会用它才行。”
“学削皮？”

“龙爷说过，刀工是割烹里最重要的一环。”余盛挥挥手要枣儿先忙自个儿的工作。“你早点做完我就教你。”
“没问题。”一听余盛愿教，枣儿整个劲儿都来啦！
她利落地汲水将一篓脏布洗得干干净净，每一条都方方整整挂着晾好后，才绽着笑来到余盛身边。
“余盛哥……”瞧她唤得多甜。
“呐。”余盛要她坐下，然后递了把刀给她。“注意看着，刀要贴着果皮，滑过去，不是削，用的力道要足，但下手要轻。”
“是滑不是削……”枣儿盯看了会儿，才拾了块用剩的黄瓜段，试着照做。
“呦，不错。”余盛看着枣儿的动作夸着。“想不到你手挺巧的。”
枣儿憨笑，她削皮功夫佳，还不是因为家贫——凡可以利用绝不浪费，向来是枣儿奉行不悖的硬道理。
第1章(2)
两人的举动，立在暗处的龙焱全看在眼里，他点点头，算是认可了石草的努力。
就如余盛说的，学习割烹最重要就是手巧眼利，缺了这两项，难以成器。
这时外边人喊着余盛，余盛留下枣儿一个人离开。
龙焱悄然无声地步出，专心练习的枣儿好半晌才发觉身旁多了双黑缎子鞋，一想起那鞋是谁的，她差点没吓破胆。
“龙爷。”她怯怯站起，手里削了一半的黄瓜藏也不是，丢也不是。
龙爷什么时候来的？也不先出个声……
“你试试。”龙焱从篮子里拾了一条莱菔，递给石草。
枣儿瞧瞧他又瞧瞧莱菔，一时揣不出龙焱心思。
“聋了？”
她连忙摇头，忙接过来作势要削。
“坐着。”龙焱踢了一把矮凳过去。

枣儿这才“咚”地坐下。她刚才不坐，是觉得不妥，当家的站得那么高，她这个小杂工哪好意思坐着工作！
拿着圆胖的莱菔喘了两口气，枣儿专注地操使手里的小刀，这可不能闹着玩，她很清楚刀之锋利，一没拿稳，削掉的可就是她的皮。
没一会儿，一条莱菔轻巧地解了身上粗皮，龙焱取了一段皮检视，再丢进脚边的皮渣盆里。
这小子确实有天分。龙焱点点头。昨儿他经过井边，不经意瞥见石草边洗碗，边沾着盘上残余的酱汁品尝。灶房每每得空，这小子也会挨着三厨四厨问些割烹的技巧——这些事龙焱全看在眼里。可说也怪，中午忙过了一阵，回头却不见石草身影，龙焱这才纳闷寻来。
content_en:
After working in the "one-stop shop" for a long time, Zao'er finally understood how hard her father worked. She came home from work that day and was so tired that she couldn't even eat, so she just wiped her hands and feet and went to sleep.
It was still dark the next day, so Zao'er got up early as usual. There was still some time before it was time to go to work. Zao'er hurriedly carried the bamboo basket and water scoop to the vegetable garden behind the house, thinking that she would help her father prepare food for the whole day later.
"I was really scared to death yesterday. Listening to Mr. Long's tone, I thought I would probably never work in Yilong. How did I know that he just thought that I couldn't bear the burden of water? It's really strange, considering how high his status is, he would actually think about the people under his command..."
Talking in the vegetable garden has been Zaoer's habit since she was a child. She stayed alone in the empty house all day long, and her mother died young. When she had something to say, of course she had to talk to Guo Guo Cai Su, who didn't know how to respond.
As she spoke, Long Yan's handsome face, firm jaw, straight eyebrows, and a pair of bottomless black eyes appeared in her mind. Although Zaoer has not seen many men, she can guarantee that this young man is definitely one of the most handsome men in the neighborhood.
"I thought he was older and more fierce, but I didn't expect him to be so young. He might not even be old enough yet!"
While talking, Zao'er's hands were not idle. Her hands were like colorful butterflies. She poured a full ladle of water on each seedling.
Soon, Zaoer picked a small basket of pods. She stood up with a "Hey!", wiped her sweat and prepared to go home and cook. As she was walking, she suddenly let out a soft "Ouch!"
"Look at my head!"
She held the basket and hurried home to dig out the coarse clothes she had worn last night. How could she forget that after work last night, the accounting clerk gave her half a piece of bacon, saying it was a gift from the boss to her father.
Who knew she was tired and confused? She stuffed the bacon into her arms and immediately forgot about it!
Zao'er carefully patted off the cloth residue stuck to the bacon, sniffed it, and looked intoxicated. It is indeed the bacon made by the famous "Yilong", it is very fragrant. She was thinking about her father's thin body, so she could take this opportunity to help him make up some oil.
Soon, she cut a few pieces of meat and stir-fried it with garlic sprouts, then served it with a pot of gruel. As soon as the dishes and chopsticks were put away, her father came smelling the aroma.
"Be careful." Zaoer hurriedly went to help.
"Where did this bacon come from?" Shi Laolu sat down, pressing his injured waist.
"Master Long gave it to you." Zao'er quickly filled a bowl of porridge and put a chopstick of meat into her father's bowl. "Try it."
"I never thought I would have the opportunity to eat bacon this year." Shi Laolu chewed with bright eyes.
"Yi Long" is not stingy with his subordinates. Every Chinese New Year, the boss will always give each of them half a leg of waxed lamb as a gift. Zao'er always uses it carefully and carefully, but how long can half a leg of lamb be eaten? It's only a few months, and she can only recall the good taste in her sleep.
"You should eat some too." Shi Laolu put a few pieces of meat into Zao'er's bowl. "Is work okay? I saw you fell asleep when you got home, so I didn't dare to disturb you."
Zao'er answered while eating the porridge. At the end, he added a few thoughts: "Long Ye's cutting skills are so amazing! I'll bring the plate in and watch him chop, chop, chop, then put it in the pot and turn it over again. A plate of 'silver-threaded beef' will be ready."
Shi Laolu raised his voice and asked, "Are you just standing there watching?"
"Yeah, what's wrong?"
"How could this happen!" Shi Laolu slapped his forehead. "Yesterday, you heard from Father Huang that Master Long is most taboo about women entering his kitchen. Although you are disguised as a boy now, you are still a girl after all!"
Zaoer pouted. "I just want to learn some skills secretly..."
Long Yan, known as "The Reincarnation of Yi Ya", is so exquisite in his craftsmanship that even Zaoer, who never leaves home, knows about it. Besides, she was naturally interested in Kappo food and drink. It was a rare opportunity for her to take a closer look, and it would kill her not to look at it!
"Think about how good Mr. Long is to us." Shi Laolu nodded at the garlic sprouts and bacon on the table, and said sincerely.Advising: "He only has these few rules, how can you bear to disobey them?"
"...Okay!" Zao'er was reluctant. "But I really don't understand, why does Mr. Long exclude women from entering the kitchen? There is a saying in ancient times, 'a gentleman stays away from the kitchen'..."
"Master Long hates women." Shi Laolu answered his daughter's doubts. "It seems because when Mr. Long was a child, his mother left him and his father and ran away with someone else."
That’s it! Zaoer opened her mouth in shock.
"This matter must not be brought up in front of Lord Long, remember." Shi Laolu warned again and again.
Since she allowed her father to stop poking around in the kitchen, from the next day, Zaoer gave up the habit of poking around the windows and doors of the longhouse.
"What a pity." Zao'er, who was standing in the plate room wiping cups and plates, sighed. It's rare to work in a "one-stop" service, and it's rare to be so close to the kitchen - it's right next door, but she can only stand here and smell the aroma, while imagining how Mr. Long will stir up the pot and dance...
"It's nice to be a boy." She murmured quietly and put the wiped plate on the shelf with her hands.
"What's wrong? I heard you moaning and sighing all morning." Yu Sheng, who was responsible for peeling fruits in the village, was passing by with a basket of radish and couldn't help but poke his head out of curiosity.
"Good morning, Brother Yu Sheng." Zao'er said hello and put the last plate away before carrying a basket full of dirty cloths to Yu Sheng's side. Yu Sheng was about five years older than Zao'er, and although he was his senior, because of his amiable nature and the fact that he hung out in the same place - also by a well, Zao'er had only known him for a short time, and the two immediately became familiar with each other.
"I was just thinking about my father's instructions, asking me not to go near the kitchen and disturb Mr. Long."
Yu Sheng laughed twice. "You want to learn Kappo?"
Zaoer, who wanted to be seen through, was a little embarrassed. "It's a bit interesting..."
"If you want to learn, you've entered the wrong door!" As soon as he arrived at the well, Yu Sheng immediately put down the basket and patted the sharp thin blade inside. "You have to learn to use it first."
"Learn to peel?"
"Long Ye said that knife skills are the most important part of Kappou." Yu Sheng waved his hand and asked Zao'er to do his own work first. "If you finish it early, I will teach you."
"No problem." Once she heard that Yu Sheng was willing to teach, Zaoer became very excited!
She collected water neatly and washed a basket of dirty cloths cleanly. After hanging each piece neatly in a square shape to dry, she came to Yu Sheng's side with a smile on her face.
"Brother Yu Sheng..." Look how sweet she called him.
"Now." Yu Sheng asked her to sit down, and then handed her a knife. "Watch carefully. The knife should be close to the peel and slide over it, not cut. Use enough force but be gentle."
"Is it smoothing, not peeling..." Zao'er stared at it for a while, then picked up a leftover cucumber segment and tried to do it.
"Yo, not bad." Yu Sheng praised Zao'er's movements. "I didn't expect you to be very handy."
Zao'er smiled naively. She was good at peeling, not because her family was poor - anything that could be used should not be wasted. This had always been a strong principle that Zao'er adhered to.
Chapter 1(2)
Long Yan, who was standing in the dark, saw all the actions of the two of them. He nodded, acknowledging Shi Cao's efforts.
As Yu Sheng said, the most important thing in learning Kappou is dexterity and vision. Without these two items, it will be difficult to succeed.
At this time, people outside called Yu Sheng, and Yu Sheng left Zaoer alone.
Long Yan stepped out quietly, and it took Zao'er, who was concentrating on practicing, to realize that there was a pair of black satin shoes next to her. She was almost frightened when she thought of whose shoes those shoes belonged to.
"Master Long." She stood up timidly, not hiding the half-cut cucumber in her hand, nor throwing it away.
When did Mr. Long come? Without making a sound first...
"Try it." Long Yan picked up a radish from the basket and handed it to Shi Cao.
Zao'er looked at him and then at Lai Fu, unable to guess what Long Yan was thinking.
"Deaf?"
She shook her head quickly and took it over to cut it.
"Sit down." Long Yan kicked a low stool over.
Zaoer then sat down with a thud. She didn't sit down just now because she was sleepingThat's not right, the head of the house stands so tall, how dare she, a little handyman, sit down and work!
Holding the plump radish and taking a few breaths, Zaoer focused on using the knife in her hand. This was no joke. She knew very well how sharp the knife was. If she didn't hold it firmly, her skin would be peeled off.
After a while, a piece of radish gently untied its rough skin. Long Yan took a piece of skin, examined it, and then threw it into the skin dregs basin at his feet.
This guy does have talent. Long Yan nodded. Yesterday, he passed by the well and accidentally caught a glimpse of Shi Cao washing dishes and tasting the remaining sauce on the plate. Whenever the kitchen was free, this boy would go to the three and four chefs and ask about the cooking techniques - Long Yan saw all these things. Strangely enough, after being busy for a while at noon, Shi Cao was nowhere to be seen when he turned around, so Long Yan was puzzled to find him.
